IncidentBot: ALERT: GPU capacity exhaustion detected in eu-west-1-pool-5. autoscaler failed to add nodes (limit_reached). queue_length=1243, avg_latency=1.8s, error_rate=8%. Trigger: traffic surge after recent model rollout (v33).

Maya (oncall-eng): paging oncall. I'm on it, looking at pool.

Maya (oncall-eng): quick metric dump:
```
gpu_pool: eu-west-1-pool-5
active_gpus: 96/96
pending_scale_requests: 3
autoscaler_status: REJECTED (quota_limit)
request_queue: 1243
avg_inference_latency_p50: 0.98s
avg_inference_latency_p95: 1.8s
kv_cache_ops/sec: +420% vs baseline
```

Chris (eng-sre): seeing huge KV cache growth. Looks like model v33 increased context window & prefix materialization. Prefill + long-context requests are amplifying per-request GPU time.

Jamal (runtime): Confirmed. v33 changed the tokenizer behavior and switched on aggressive kvcache prefetch for short-term perf. That backfired under high concurrency. KV cache warmups are saturating GPU memory and preventing new allocations -> queue pileup.

Maya (oncall-eng): Mitigations in flight:
- Remove v33 from routing (canary rollback)
- Disable prefill/warmup path on rollout nodes
- Route traffic to fallback model v32-small for non-critical customers
- Open emergency capacity request to infra (if autoscaler continues to reject)

Lukas (sre-scheduler): I've attempted a manual scale up but cloud quota blocks it. Asking infra-quotas team now (ticket #Q-18912).

Maya (oncall-eng): Doing the routing rollback now: `redwood route update --pool eu-west-1-pool-5 --remove-model v33 --add-model v32-small --ratio 80:20`

IncidentBot: ACTION: Routing change applied by Maya at 1767002380. Observability: route-steering events emitted.

Morgan (support): Heads-up: support queue spiking, customers reporting 502s and timeouts. I flagged the top 6 affected customers (account IDs: A-1324, A-1987, A-2201). Communicating now.

Priya (product): Which customers hit SLAs? Need to prefill comms.

Maya (oncall-eng): Estimated impact: ~12% of production traffic hit fallback or timed out. 6 customers with >5% error-rate, 2 customers with >20% errors. Preliminary MTTI: 00:32 from rollback start.

Jamal (runtime): Disabled kvcache prefetch on the rollout group with a feature-flag flip: `ROLLOUT_PREFETCH=false` (applied to nodes tagged v33-rollout). That freed ~18GB GPU per node in the initial tests.

Chris (eng-sre): After rollback + prefetch disable: queue_length -> 210, avg_latency_p95 -> 0.72s. Errors down to 1.2%. Still watching allocation churn.

IncidentBot: NOTIFICATION: Pager duty acknowledged by Chris at 1767002520.

Lukas (sre-scheduler): Quota request approved for ephemeral burst to eu-west-1 for 2 hours. Spinning additional nodes now.

Maya (oncall-eng): Spun temporary burst pool (eu-west-1-pool-5-burst) and moved non-critical traffic there to soak. Command: `redwood pool create --name eu-west-1-pool-5-burst --size 16 --temp`

Jamal (runtime): Pool came up but warming took 90s per node. We preemptively disabled kvcache warmup on the burst pool to avoid immediate saturation.

Chris (eng-sre): Current numbers (post-mitigation snapshot):
```
request_queue: 78
active_gpus: 112/112 (incl. burst)
avg_latency_p95: 0.65s
error_rate: 0.6%
kv_cache_ops/sec: down to +40% vs baseline
```

Priya (product): Good. Prep status: we'll send a customer note summarizing impact and that rollback + temporary capacity resolved the immediate issue. Drafting now.

Morgan (support): Sending interim messages to the 6 affected customers: apology, incident title, mitigation steps, ETA for postmortem.

Maya (oncall-eng): Handoff: Chris will take primary oncall for the next shift. I'll document the mitigation timeline and link logs. Chris, please pick up runbook and postmortem owner.

Chris (eng-sre): Taking handoff. I'll triage the root cause and coordinate with runtime team for a long-term fix. Assigning postmortem to Jamal + Priya.

Jamal (runtime): Next actions:
- Reproduce load profile in staging with v33 + long context + prefill to measure kvcache growth.
- Add safety caps on kvcache allocation per-request and fallback to streaming decode when mem threshold approached.
- Add rollout gating to require perf regression test for kv ops under concurrent warmup.

Priya (product): Also want rollback gating in console: auto-block if queue growth > 200 and autoscaler rejects more than 1 scale request within 5m.

Maya (oncall-eng): Creating incident ticket INC-2026-1767002222 and attaching immediate timeline + commands executed.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT: INC-2026-1767002222 created by Maya. Severity: Sev2 -> customer-facing degraded performance.

Morgan (support): All 6 customers have received interim updates. No escalations to legal yet.

Chris (eng-sre): Handoff note: observed that autoscaler didn't bubble a clear error; we lost visibility of quota rejection path. Action: add explicit alert when autoscaler rejects due to provider_quota with link to quota ticket.

Jamal (runtime): Will draft a kvcache safety PR and a perf test harness for long-context prefill flows. ETA 3 days for PR, 1 week for test infra.

Priya (product): Postmortem owner assigned: Jamal. I'll coordinate customer communications postmortem.

Maya (oncall-eng): Final check: queue stable, errors low, burst pool will drain at 1767008822. Handing off to Chris.

Chris (eng-sre): Acknowledged. I'll run the detailed RCA and link to the postmortem doc. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: resolved state set to "mitigated - ongoing RCA" at 1767004022.
